                  aria-label="Filter MCP server status"
                  value={status}
                  onChange={(event) => setStatus(event.target.value)}

                  {[
                    "connected",
                    "connecting",
                    "disabled",
                    "disconnected",
                    "failed",
                    "authentication_required",
                  ].map((value) => (
                    <option key={value} value={value}>
                      {stateLabel(value)}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>

                  setError("Import files must be 256 KiB or smaller.");

                setImportText(await file.text());
                setPreview(null);
                setError("");
              }}
            />

<button
              disabled={writeBlocked || !preview || !importSelection.length}
              onClick={() => {
                clearAction();
                setConfirmation({
                  title: `Import ${importSelection.length} server configurations?`,
                  operation: "import",
                  data: {
                    configs: importSelection.map(
                      (index) => preview!.candidates[index],
                    ),
                  },
                  description:
                    "Selected configurations are saved disabled. No process starts, no network connection is made, and no tools are approved.",
                });
              }}
            >
              Import selected
            </button>

rows.source_excerpt:
<button
              className={action.kind === "forget" ? "danger-button" : ""}
              disabled={
                busy ||
                !connected ||
                ((action.kind === "correct" ||
                  action.kind === "analyze" ||
                  action.kind === "alias" ||
                  action.kind === "workflow" ||
                  (action.kind === "review" && action.edit)) &&
                  !content.trim())
              }
              onClick={apply}
            >
              {busy
                ? "Savingâ€¦"
                : action.kind === "forget"
                  ? "Delete memory"
                  : action.kind === "review"
                    ? action.decision === "approve"
                      ? "Approve memory"
                      : action.decision === "reject"
                        ? "Reject suggestion"
                        : "Dismiss suggestion"
                    : action.kind === "analyze"
                      ? "Create suggestion"
                      : action.kind === "consolidate"
                        ? "Find suggestions"
                        : "Save change"}
            </button>

rows.source_excerpt:
<textarea
          data-mini-input
          ref={input}
          aria-label="Message HANNI"
          value={draft}
          maxLength={4000}
          rows={2}
          placeholder="Ask HANNI, or / for tools"
          onChange={(event) => setDraft(event.target.value)}
          onKeyDown={(event) => {
            if (event.nativeEvent.isComposing) return;
            if (
              commandMode &&
              capabilities.length &&
              ["ArrowDown", "ArrowUp"].includes(event.key)
            ) {
              event.preventDefault();
              setSelection(
                (value) =>
                  (value +
                    (event.key === "ArrowDown" ? 1 : capabilities.length - 1)) %
                  capabilities.length,
              );
            } else if (event.key === "Enter" && !event.shiftKey) {
              event.preventDefault();
              commandMode && capabilities.length
                ? prepare(
                    capabilities[Math.min(selection, capabilities.length - 1)]
                      .name,
                  )
                : submit();
            }
          }}
        />

rows.source_excerpt:
<select
                  aria-label="Model endpoint"
                  value={suite?.model_required ? endpointId : ""}
                  disabled={!suite?.model_required}
                  onChange={(e) => setEndpointId(e.target.value)}
                >
                  <option value="">
                    {suite?.model_required
                      ? "Select an eligible endpoint"
                      : "No model Â· retrieval only"}
                  </option>
                  {data.models.map((m) => {
                    const enabled = m.benchmark_suites.find(
                      (s) => s.suite_id === suiteId,
                    )?.enabled;
                    return (
                      <option
                        key={m.endpoint_id}
                        value={m.endpoint_id}
                        disabled={!enabled}
                      >
                        {m.configured_model_file ||
                          m.configured_model ||
                          m.label}
                        {enabled ? "" : " Â· unavailable"}
                      </option>
                    );
                  })}
                </select>
rows.reason: Original model-required endpoint options are disabled by benchmark eligibility on the controlled unavailable model. Routing-development explicitly disables the endpoint field because it uses no model. No eligible model option selection is possible in this fixture.

<button
                        className="text-link"
                        onClick={() => {
                          if (link.kind === "file")
                            prepare(
                              `Open the file at ${link.target}. Use the existing file capability and its permission checks.`,
                            );
                          else {
                            if (storeInspection("chat", link.target))
                              navigate("chat");
                            else
                              setError(
                                "The message target could not be retained. Open Conversation and inspect its history.",
                              );
                          }
                        }}
                      >
                        {link.label}
                      </button>

            {resource.data.devices.map((d) => (

              </option>
            ))}
            {value !== "auto" &&
              !resource.data.devices.some((d) => d.id === value) && (
                <option value={value}>Saved device Â· unavailable</option>
              )}
          </select>

<textarea
        ref={inputRef}
        id="chat-input"
        value={draft}
        onChange={(e) => setDraft(e.target.value)}
        disabled={!ready}
        maxLength={4000}
        rows={2}
        placeholder={
          ready
            ? "Ask HANNI anythingâ€¦"
            : stopping
              ? "This session is stopping."
              : chat.error
                ? "Connection unavailable. Your draft stays here."
                : !chat.data
                  ? "Checking assistant availability."
                  : "Assistant is not ready. Inspect model status."
        }
        aria-describedby="chat-help chat-error"
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey && !e.nativeEvent.isComposing) {
            e.preventDefault();
            submit();
          }
        }}
      />
